text: 其中周一至周五分别到期2240亿元、2365亿元、4265亿元、6260亿元、4505亿元。此外，周二将有1000亿元国库现金定存到期。
text_en: From Monday to Friday, maturing amounts are 224 billion yuan, 236.5 billion yuan, 426.5 billion yuan, 626 billion yuan, and 450.5 billion yuan, respectively. Additionally, 100 billion yuan in Treasury cash deposits mature on Tuesday.
